tasks.title: Email advisory on Land subdivision
tasks.description: This email provided legal advice regarding the reduction in land area and the site development fees applicable to a land parcel located within the Gahanga Site Plan. It explains that the portion of land allocated for public infrastructure is not subject to expropriation because it falls within the 30% threshold established under the National Land Authority's land readjustment framework. The email further confirmed the applicable site development fee, explains its legal basis and calculation, clarifies that investment incentives do not exempt the owner from payment of the fee, and recommends payment of the fee to enable the registration and issuance of the new UPIs and land titles.
